eps-indi-b.why: Epsilon Indi B, detector 6, May 2025 to April 2026 (364 days; 20 and 10 photos; mean of the positions in each photo): measured shift 4.78 +- 0.15 arcsec (east +4.04 +- 0.15, north -2.57 +- 0.16); catalogue 4.66 arcsec (east +3.97, north -2.45), parallax included. The shift is 31.1 times its error from zero (rule: at least 3) and differs from the catalogue by +0.5 and -0.7 times its error in east and north (rule: within 3). Control: 14 field stars moved by (+0.12 +- 0.04, +0.09 +- 0.04) arcsec on average between the same visits, scatter (0.14, 0.15) arcsec, which is in the error. That scatter is the robust one; with every star counted fully it is (0.59, 0.32) arcsec, and then the shift is 9.0 times its error from zero and +0.1 and -0.4 times from the catalogue: the rule is met that way too.

wise0855.why: WISE 0855-0714, detector 6, November 2025 to April 2026 (166 days; 18 and 21 photos; position in the co-add of each visit): measured shift 3.15 +- 0.83 arcsec (east -3.13 +- 0.83, north +0.36 +- 0.76); catalogue 4.57 arcsec (east -4.53, north +0.54), parallax included. The shift is 3.8 times its error from zero (rule: at least 3) and differs from the catalogue by +1.7 and -0.2 times its error in east and north (rule: within 3). Control: 32 field stars moved by (-0.12 +- 0.03, +0.15 +- 0.04) arcsec on average between the same visits, scatter (0.18, 0.22) arcsec, which is in the error. That scatter is the robust one; with every star counted fully it is (0.25, 0.30) arcsec, and then the shift is 3.7 times its error from zero and +1.7 and -0.2 times from the catalogue: the rule is met that way too. Measured again from only the photos with no unusable pixel round the target (5 and 16): 4.91 +- 0.68 arcsec (east -4.71 +- 0.66, north +1.41 +- 0.81), 7.3 times its error from zero and -0.2 and +1.1 times from the catalogue: the rule is met with those photos too.
